summary: Botetourt County tower the FFLA marks gone; a topo map shows a nearby Tower feature named Eagle Mountain Lookout, with no source on what still stands.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone. A topo map shows a Tower feature nearby under another name; no source describes what, if anything, remains at either point.

notes_for_editor: Only two register-free sources: the FFLA lists (both pages agree on gone, Botetourt, 37.63221, -79.83051) and one topo-map site. The topo site names the feature Eagle Mountain Lookout, about 0.2 km from the FFLA point; the identity is an inference, not stated by either source. Consider adding Eagle Mountain Lookout as an other_name if the editor accepts that link. No source gives a build date, design, height, builder, agency, staffing, fires or access. The story says so only for the site today.
